people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: It will come to pass, when Yahweh has done to my lord according to all the good that he has spoken concerning you, and has appointed you prince over Israel,
translations.bsb: When the LORD has done for my lord all the good He promised, and when He has appointed you ruler over Israel,
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee, and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel;
translations.asv: And it shall come to pass, when Jehovah shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee, and shall have appointed thee prince over Israel,
